title: The Neutral Relay Siege
logline: An orbital communications curator besieged by striking dockworkers and corporate security claims impartial neutrality, hiding that he was the anonymous leaker who provoked the strike in the first place.

roles.description: Keeper of the station's unencrypted historical comms buoy; stubborn, idealistic, and terrified of taking sides.
Leader of the freight handlers' union who insists the relay logs will prove management opened fire first.
Corporate station security chief determined to seize and sanitize the logs before they reach the system tribunal.
An armed tugboat outfitted with bolted-on armor plate and industrial cutting lasers.
An isolated solar-powered antenna spar anchored three hundred kilometers off the main station ring.
A militant coalition of dockworkers, loader pilots, and crane technicians.

public_situation: An armed standoff erupts around the neutral communications relay outpost off {system} after striking dockworkers and corporate security converge on the isolated antenna spar.
private_truth: {role:relay_curator} anonymously leaked the corporate memo that sparked the strike to avenge his sister's firing. He is hiding behind his neutral charter to avoid execution as the instigator.

beats.public_change: Both union picketers and corporate security gunboats scramble towards {role:comms_relay_outpost}.

missions.reason: He needs an independent pilot to dock at the relay spar and retrieve the master transmission cryptographic token before either faction docks.
missions.private_fact: The token contains the private encryption key he used to beam the leaked corporate wage docket onto the union bulletin board.

beats.public_change: Corporate gunboats declare an exclusion zone around the relay spar, demanding the curator surrender transmission records.

missions.reason: She hires an outside pilot to scan the relay transmitter to identify which workstation terminal originated the unauthorized leak.
missions.private_fact: Her board authorized her to scuttle the entire spar if the leaker cannot be extradited for corporate tribunal.

beats.public_change: A union gunboat blocks the transit lane to the habitat concourse, demanding the curator release management's emergency deployment codes.

missions.reason: He begs the pilot to disable the union vessel so he can purge the relay archives before union hackers breach his terminal.
missions.private_fact: He knows if the strikers learn he caused the violence that got three picketers killed, they will lynch him as a reckless saboteur.

beats.public_change: Security patrols and armed union freighters prepare for a full-scale battle outside {role:comms_relay_outpost}.

missions.reason: She hires the pilot to secure the relay airlock so the union can recruit the anonymous whistleblower to direct their defense.
missions.private_fact: {role:security_director} hails offering station immunity and a bounty if the pilot turns over the cryptographic token identifying the instigator.

player_choice.prompt: With the cryptographic token in hand and both factions surrounding the relay, the pilot must decide whether to protect the curator, sell him out, or expose his instigation.

options.label: Purge the transmission archives and extract {role:relay_curator} to preserve his neutrality
Sell the cryptographic token to {role:security_director} to expose the curator
Deliver the token and confession to {role:strike_captain} so the union knows the truth

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot purges the logs and extracts the curator.
resolutions.summary: {role:relay_curator} purges his workstation and slips away into unaligned space. Neither faction ever learns who leaked the memo, leaving the strike deadlocked.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot wiped communications archives at a contested relay, keeping the origins of a dock strike buried.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot sells the cryptographic token to the security director.
resolutions.summary: {role:security_director} uses the token to prove {role:relay_curator} instigated the dispute. The curator is imprisoned and the strike is crushed under martial law.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot handed encrypted tokens to station security, exposing the curator who secretly started a dock strike.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the token and confession to the strike captain.
resolutions.summary: {role:strike_captain} learns the curator sparked the strike over personal vengeance. The union expels {role:relay_curator} but uses the corporate leak to seize station docks.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot brought proof that a neutral comms curator secretly manufactured the dock strike for personal payback.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot never intervenes or abandons the relay.
resolutions.summary: Security forces storm the relay spar, destroying the antennas and arresting {role:relay_curator}. The true source of the leak remains an unresolved station mystery.

loose_threads.detail: The relay's telemetry transmission log shows an encrypted secondary stream directed towards an offshore intelligence vessel.
The rifles carried by the union picket carry serial numbers traced to a corporate security depot inventory write-off.

radio_hooks: Independent relay spar outside {system} surrounded by rival armed cutters following dock clash.
Station security issues ultimatum to communications curator demanding unedited incident logs.
Freight union leadership accuses management of manufacturing communications blackout.

voice_direction.relay_curator: Fastidious, tremulous, and constantly cites archival bylaws. Becomes shrill and desperate when pressured to take a side.
voice_direction.strike_captain: Hoarse, passionate, and blunt. Uses rough dockyard vernacular and treats anyone who hesitates as an enemy.
voice_direction.security_director: Crisp, measured, and patronizing. Uses polite corporate phrasing to deliver lethal threats.
